deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page. It is a blue paper wrapper or cover sheet of the bundle 'R.Waermeleitung'. The only writing is a column of pencil notes in the upper left corner. Each note pairs a number (about 167–170, twice abbreviated as 70 and 68) with a date: 23.3.89, 18.11.77, 29.10.79, 11.8.82, 12.2.91, 12.7.94, 16.1.95.

The dates run from the 1970s to the 1990s, long after Riemann's death in 1866. The notes are therefore by later archive or library staff. The numbers stay nearly constant (167.5–170). They are most plausibly repeated archival checks of the bundle, either leaf or page counts or weighings in grams. The first line is in a different, larger hand, and a curved line loosely brackets the upper entries. Neither changes this reading.

Nothing here was written by Riemann, and there is no derivation to reconstruct. The page's only value is as provenance: it records that the bundle was checked repeatedly in the late 20th century.
